findings: Visual identity and gross placement are coherent. These observations do not establish native solder, motor support, fastener, wiring, vibration or flight qualification.

checks.finding: One quadrotor assembly contains four rotor groups and one central electronics stack.
The long narrow native OpenFrame body and four diagonal arms retain the original 226 mm frame proportions.
Four tri-blade envelopes, both gold camera side plates and the green native board stack are visible.
No detached duplicate board or spare motor body appears outside the assembled frame.
Motor envelopes align with all four arm ends and both boards align with the central support rings; actual fastener and solder load paths remain unqualified.
Two blue rotors occupy the left corners and two orange rotors the right corners in the top view; the camera plates sit at the front end.
The square top view and isometric view show the same four arms, stacked plates and board positions without clipping.
